internship.title: Product Design Internship
internship.description: A role-specific Product Design Internship built around realistic assignments, detailed learning, practical work, validation, review and a final capstone.
internship.learningModel: learn -> inspect -> practice -> deliver -> validate -> review -> iterate
expectations: Complete every practical and dedicated task.
Follow professional quality and collaboration practices.
completionRequirements: Explain submitted work during final review.

modules.title: Product design onboarding
modules.description: Learn product design onboarding through realistic internship work. Students connect the concept to a real product/data problem, inspect existing work, implement or design a focused solution, validate it and prepare evidence for review.

lessons.title: Product design onboarding — Internship Lesson
lessons.description: Learn product design onboarding through realistic internship work. Students connect the concept to a real product/data problem, inspect existing work, implement or design a focused solution, validate it and prepare evidence for review.
learningObjectives: Apply it to the internship project.

notes.text: Learn product design onboarding through realistic internship work. Students connect the concept to a real product/data problem, inspect existing work, implement or design a focused solution, validate it and prepare evidence for review.

This is not a theory-only lesson. Treat the module like a real assignment: understand the requirement, inspect the existing project or data, make a focused change, validate the result, document decisions and prepare the work for review.

notes.alt: Product Design Internship — Product design onboarding
notes.caption: Add a dedicated annotated visual, diagram, screenshot or data-flow illustration for Product design onboarding. The visual should teach the concept.

notes.text: First understand the problem behind product design onboarding. Then learn the relevant technique, apply it to the internship project, verify the result and explain why the chosen approach is appropriate.

items: Read the requirement or issue.
Inspect the current design/code/data before changing it.
Break the work into small steps.
Implement or design the solution.
Validate using tests, review, usability checks or data-quality checks as appropriate.
Check an edge or failure case.
Compare the result with acceptance criteria.
Document the result and limitations.

notes.code:
Internship scenario: Product design onboarding

Goal: Apply this skill to a realistic learning-platform requirement.

Workflow: requirement -> inspect -> plan -> implement/design -> validate -> review -> document.

items: Starting implementation before understanding the requirement.
Ignoring edge cases, empty states or data-quality issues.
Skipping validation or review.
Using inconsistent patterns instead of project conventions.
Submitting work without explaining decisions.
Keep work focused and reviewable.
Use consistent naming and structure.
Validate assumptions with evidence.
Consider accessibility, security, performance and reliability where relevant.
Document important decisions and known limitations.
I can explain Product design onboarding in my own words.
I can apply it to a realistic project problem.
I can validate the result.
I can identify an edge case or risk.
I can explain my decisions during review.

practicals.title: Guided Practical — Product design onboarding
practicals.objective: Apply Product design onboarding to a realistic Product Design Internship assignment.
practicals.starterPrompt: Complete a realistic internship assignment for Product design onboarding: implement/design the assigned feature, validate it and submit evidence.
practicals.expectedOutput: A working or review-ready result demonstrating Product design onboarding.

tasks.title: Internship Task — Product design onboarding
tasks.description: Complete a realistic internship assignment for Product design onboarding: implement/design the assigned feature, validate it and submit evidence.

codeReviewChecklist: Risks and edge cases are considered.

options: Apply the skill to a realistic Product Design Internship assignment
quiz.answer: Apply the skill to a realistic Product Design Internship assignment
